facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: fire on PR-9410 during shift handover

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control DROP_ZONE_EXCLUSION: the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control LIFTING_GEAR_INSPECTION: the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.
Control LIFT_STUDY_APPROVAL: the preparation and approval of a lift study was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work on PR-9410 and M-9410 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the preparation and approval of a lift study on PR-9410 and M-9410 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and executing a lift, specifically directing a lift and controlling the drop zone. PR-9410 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during shift handover while the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work had been bypassed. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 21 September 2012 an incident occurred on PR-9410 and M-9410 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during shift handover, releasing gravity energy held as suspended load.
